# Conformance

<!-- Generated by scripts/conformance.py; edit conformance.json. -->

Milestones 0–5 with bounded local 3D product semantics and independent geometry Milestones 6–19; no complete ISO edition or AP conformance claim; selected faceted and edge-based planar STEP import; existing triangulated and presentation tessellation import with discovery, representation selection and C/C++ entry points (Milestone 20); curved B-rep import with elementary, B-spline and swept geometry pole/apex charts and cavity shells; root and context-unit discovery.

Implemented means the named behavior has regression evidence, not that the full
standard or future semantic layer has been certified. No AP conformance is claimed.

The JSON manifest tracks physical syntax, the EXPRESS frontend and generated bindings.
Structural schema decoding and product graph adaptation are separate checked stages.
Independent analytic/NURBS curves and surfaces are tested separately from STEP geometry adaptation.
Constructed topology, UV loops, adaptive tessellation and owned mesh checks are independent stages.
Selected faceted, edge-based planar and curved B-rep STEP import, existing triangulated and presentation tessellation import,
assembly linking and surface colours are implemented;
AP conformance and industrial hardening remain future work.

See [PART21.md](PART21.md), [ERROR_MODEL.md](ERROR_MODEL.md) and
[VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) for exact behavior and actual verification results.
